title.narrative: Study of Floristic Composition of Lawachara and Satchari forests with special emphasis on the conservation status of two Reserved Forests of Bangladesh.

description.narrative: The Lawachara and Satchari- two reserve forests in Bangladesh are rich in invaluable plant resources. They are also abode of rare birds and animals. In recent years, there has been increasing use of resources of the forests including rise of ecotourism in these areas. At this backdrop, the objective of this project is to study the floristic composition of these forests, mapping the forests and assess the conservation status with a view to ensure sustainable use of resources by the forest goers and users. The project aims to raise awareness about the importance of conserving these forests' biodiversity among the stakeholders and ultimately to prepare an application for Biosphere Reserve.
